svg.title: Primary behavioral distance A, 239 scenarios
svg.desc: SUPPLEMENTARY complete-case analysis; not completed Batch 12 or revised official experiment. Both axes list all 24 full constitution names. Darker cells indicate smaller mean binary total variation; diagonal values are zero. Use the accompanying HTML or CSV table for precise accessible values.
